briefdescription.para: Allows a caller to propogate an OpenTelemetry context from client to server.

parameterdescription.para: The traceparent part of the TraceContext in HTTP header format
The tracestate part of the TraceContext in HTTP header format

simplesect.para: Neither the tracePraent or traceState need to include the name of the HTTP header only the value. For example. An example HTTP traceparent may look like traceparent: 00-0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c-b7ad6b7169203331-01 The caller should only supply the actual value. There is no need to include the "traceparent:" prefix. If the "traceparent:" prefix is also included, it will be removed.

memberdef.argsstring: (rbusHandle_t rbus, char *traceParent, int traceParentLength, char *traceState, int traceStateLength)
memberdef.name: rbusHandle_GetTraceContextAsString

briefdescription.para: rbus.h top level include file. This is the only file a provider or client needs to include in their project.
